recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It preserves the later current-build decision not to support the retired DeviceComponent resource and fixes the only visible Observation source residue from the original STU3 application.
issue_request: FHIR-13467 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 OO change request to add DeviceComponent as an allowed Observation.device reference target alongside Device and DeviceMetric for Personal Health Device observations.
initial_application: STU3-era commits 2bc0950a1e354c2a99db1fca80954166c25bc241 and 74e12971113562df83d5022257947a15f0b27cdb applied the request by changing the Observation.device spreadsheet type to Reference(Device|DeviceComponent|DeviceMetric) and adding a spirometry example that referenced DeviceComponent.
additional_context: DeviceComponent was later removed from current-build scope: source/fhir.ini now comments out devicecomponent and lists DeviceComponent as dropped, while Observation, Device, and DeviceMetric remain active. R4-era source history and community discussion show DeviceComponent was merged into the Device model/DeviceDefinition work, and commit 7fbb1fff1d9f70f28eb68f4d1251aa670bc889bc removed DeviceComponent from Observation.device and the spirometry example.
reconciliation: Made a source-changing commit that removes the two remaining stale labels saying the spirometry example references DeviceComponent. No conformance change was made because the current StructureDefinition correctly targets Device and DeviceMetric only.
source_changes: source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml: changed the spirometry example description from 'Spirometry Example referencing DeviceComponent' to 'Spirometry Example'.
source/observation/observation-examples-header.xml: changed the spirometry example link text from 'Spirometry Example referencing DeviceComponent' to 'Spirometry Example'.

related_jiras.note: Same submitter and text as FHIR-13467; Jira marks it Duplicate, so it was not published as an independent reconciliation decision.
